free_tier.stated: During beta every account is free with no rate limit; after beta a permanent free tier with no card of at least 5,000 input tokens and 1,000 output tokens per hour (5,000 and 1,000 today), counted per account over a rolling hour across all keys.

record.tooling: an OpenAI-compatible base URL with an sk-cheap- key; Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Responses formats also work
record.chaining: the rolling-hour token allowance and the one-request-at-a-time rule bind before the per-token price

limits.value: at least 5,000 input and 1,000 output tokens per hour per account, rolling hour, all keys together
one request at a time per account; 429 while a request is running

identity_cost.detail: create an account and a dashboard key; the permanent free tier needs no card

record.reliability_note: a 429 is returned while another request from the account is running; traffic spikes queue for up to 30 seconds before a 503

evidence.proved: a permanent card-free free tier of at least 5,000 input and 1,000 output tokens per hour, counted per account over a rolling hour
evidence.quote: every account keeps a permanent free tier, with no card: at least 5,000 input tokens and 1,000 output tokens per hour

record.notes: a real standing card-free free tier exists, bounded by a rolling-hour token allowance and a one-request-at-a-time rule
